definitions.gloss: wheat bran; outer layer of wheat grain
definitions.explanation: The outer fibrous coating of wheat grain that is separated from the flour during milling. Used in animal feed, as a dietary supplement for fiber, and in some baked goods.

examples.japanese: {麸|ふすま}は{小麦|こむぎ}を{製粉|せいふん}する{際|さい}に{出|で}る{副産物|ふくさんぶつ}だ。
examples.english: Wheat bran is a byproduct of milling wheat into flour.

examples.japanese: {麸|ふすま}パンは{食物|しょくもつ}{繊維|せんい}が{豊富|ほうふ}で{健康|けんこう}によい。
examples.english: Bran bread is rich in dietary fiber and good for health.

examples.japanese: {麸|ふすま}に{含|ふく}まれる{食物|しょくもつ}{繊維|せんい}は{腸内環境|ちょうないかんきょう}を{整|ととの}える{効果|こうか}がある。
examples.english: The dietary fiber in wheat bran has the effect of improving intestinal health.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {糠|ぬか}: rice bran — the outer layer of rice removed during milling, used for pickling (ぬかづけ)
- {小麦粉|こむぎこ}: wheat flour — the white interior of the wheat grain after bran is removed

Not to be confused with {麩|ふ} (fu), a wheat-gluten product used in Japanese cuisine such as soups and hot pot.
